test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with unknown items and mixed references
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several items, including at least one product that does not exist in the catalog, using a mix of product names, item numbers, and detailed descriptions. The request cannot be fulfilled without intervention due to the presence of non-catalog items.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Items for Upcoming Event
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out to request a detailed sales quote for a selection of products we are considering for our upcoming Playlandia promotional event. We are aiming to finalize our order soon, so a timely response would be appreciated. Below is the list of items we are interested in:

1. 12 units of the WonderWagon Electric Train (Item No: AITEM-0002) – please confirm if you have this in stock for immediate delivery.
2. 20 sets of the SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set – these are intended as giveaway items for children, so please specify if there are any age recommendations or packaging options.
3. 15 units of the Playlandia Deluxe Balloon Kit – we’ve heard positive feedback about this kit from other event organizers, and we’d like to include it in our order. If you have multiple versions, please quote the standard one.
4. 10 pieces of T-Shirt, assorted sizes (Item No: AITEM-0025) – we would like a mix of sizes suitable for children ages 6-12, preferably in bright colors.
5. 8 boxes of MagicToyland Fairy Doll – please include any available accessories or bundle options.

If you require any additional information to prepare the quote, please let me know. We are hoping to receive pricing, availability, and estimated delivery times for all items listed above. If possible, please also indicate any volume discounts or promotional offers that may apply.

Best regards,
Tom Martinez

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with unknown item references
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several items, including at least one product that does not exist in the available catalog, triggering an intervention requirement.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Multiple Items (Some Details Included)
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a detailed sales quote for an upcoming project we are planning at Toytopia. We are looking to source a variety of items, some of which are quite specific to our needs. I have listed the products below, along with quantities and any relevant notes for your reference. Please let me know if you require any further information or clarification on any of the items.

1. 12 units of the WonderWagon Pull-Along Train. This is a staple in our toy lineup and we would like to ensure timely delivery if possible.
2. 8 sets of the GiggleGear Action Figures Set. Please confirm if these come in assorted character packs or if we need to specify variants.
3. 10 units of the "Deluxe Playtime Castle" (this is a new item we saw at a recent trade show, but I am not sure if it is listed under a different name in your catalog).
4. 5 boxes of Organic Carrot (AITEM-1000). Please confirm if these are available in bulk packaging.
5. 20 units of the SmartToys Fast Car Set. If there are any bundle deals for larger quantities, kindly include those options in the quote.

We are aiming for delivery by the end of next month, if possible. If any of the above items are unavailable or require substitutions, please advise on alternatives. Thank you in advance for your assistance and the detailed quote. I look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,
Jessica Stone
